content: Bonḍami edde lalsir babute Isar hokum
Hen šomot hazar hazar manuš en bafe dola oiye, hitara ṭelateli gori ekzone ar ekzonor uwore fora šuru goijje. Hetunot Isaye foila sahabi okkolor uzu firi hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara Foroši okkolor šikkattu hũšiyar, hin tũwarar gat no farafan, kiyollahoile hin bonḍami.
Guijja kissu nai, zin forhaš no oibo, edde gufon kissu nai, zin zana no zaibo.
Otoso tũwara andarot za kissu hoiyo, hin fohorot funa zaibo, edde zin góror butore hane hane ho, hin sador uwottu guzori howa oibo.
"O ãr bondu okkol, ãi tũwarare hoir, zara ga dongšo gori bade ar kissu gori no fare, hitarare no ḍoraiyo.
Harare ḍoraiba ãi tũwarare hiyan hoir. Tũwarare mari felai bade jahannamot dibar kemota zattu ase hibare ḍoro. Oi ãi tũwarare hoir, hibare ḍoro.
Fãswa fiyajjare ki dui foišaye no bese ne? Tarfore o Allaye hinor uggware o forai no fele.
En ki tũwarar matar sullun o Allattu gona ase. No ḍoraiyo, tũwara beši fiyajja okkolottuwaro aro beši dami.
"Ãi tũwarare hoir, ze honokiye manušor šaikkat ãre šikar gore, Adomor Fute o Allar firistar šaikkat hitare šikar goribo.
Kintu ze honokiye ãre manušor šaikkat ošikar gore, Adomor Fute o Allar firistar šaikkat hitare ošikar goribo.
Adomor Futor berudde honokiye hota hoile, hite maf faibo. Kintu ze honokiye Pak Ruhure hingša gore, hitare maf gora no oibo.
"Ar mainše tũwarare zẽtte sinagogot edde šašon goroyar sarme loi za, hetunot ki zuwab diba ba ki hoiba he babute sinta no goijjo.
Kiyollahoile hetunot ki howa foribo tũwarare Pak Ruhuye šikai dibo."

content: Zamilar butottu ekzon manuše Isare hodde: "Huzur, ãr báiyore ãr loi miraz borat goitto ho!"

content.text: "Bondu, tũwarar uwore bisarhar ba miraz bag gori doya hoi ãre hone tuille?"
"Hũšiyar! Har ḍoilla lalsittu nizore basai rako, kiyollahoile ekzon mainšottu zafdi forefan dón šombotti oile o, hine zibon no de."

content: Ar Isaye hitarare ei mesal kahanigan hoiye,

content.text: "Ekzon zomidaror zobinot kethõla beši oiye.
Henot hite mone mone sinta gori hodde, 'Ãi ehon ki goijjum? Ãttude hin rakibar zaga nai.'
"Bade hite hodde, 'Ãi endilla goijjum. Ãr gudam górgun bangi felai hinore ḍõr ḍõr gori banaiyum edde ãi ãr kuraffati edde ãr zinišfati okkolore heṛe zoma gori rakiyum.
Bade ãi nizor foranore hoiyum, foran, tolla bout bosorolla beša beši bala bala zinišfati dola goijja ase, há fiya gor, aram gor, asanot zibon haṛa.'
"Kintu Allaye hitare hodde, 'O bekub, aijja raitta tor foran hori loi zaiboi, toile tui in zinor bondobos goijjos, hin har oibo?'
"Ze nizolla dón zoma gore kintu Allar nozdikot dónban no hitalla hendilla oibo."

content: Allar uwore boroša goro, no ḍoraiyo

content.text: "Etolla ãi tũwarare hoir: Ki háiyum hoi foranor babute, otóba ki findiyum hoi gar babute sinta no goijjo.
Kiyollahoile foran haiddottuwaro ar ga horottuwaro ḍõr ziniš.
Hawagunor uzu so, hine no laga, ar no da. Hinottu gudam ba hãijja o nai, to kintu Allaye hitarare o ahar de. Ar tũwara to faikottuwaro bout dami!
Ho sai, tũwarar butore bafa sinta gori hone šude ek gonḍa nizor aiyu barai fariba?
Zehon tũwara hen šoṛo ham o gori no faro, toile baki befare kiyolla sinta goriba?"
"Bafi so, full ken gori bare. Hine hono ham o no gore, hor banaibolla fũta o no haṛe. Kintu ãi tũwarare hoir: Badša Soloimane hibar šomosto zak zomokottu o inor ekkanor ḍoilla nizore hãzai no fare.
Maṛot ze ker ase, zin hailla sulat felai diya oibo, hin zodi Allaye endilla gori hãzai fare, toile oh olfo biššaši okkol! Allaye tũwarare hãzaibode hiyan aro hoto beši haṭi!
Ar ki há fiya goriba in loi tũwara no baiffo, sinta no goijjo.
In okkol to zara Allare biššaš no gore hitara tuwa, kintu tũwarar bafe zane ze tũwarattu in okkolor dorhar ase.
Hinottuwaro bolke Allar raijjor talaš goro, toi in beggun o tũwarare diya oibo."
"Oh šoṛo dol, no ḍorais! Kiyollahoile tũwarar Bafor bala issa oilde, he raijjore tũwarare diya.
Tũwarattu zin ase, hin besi horat hisabe dan goro. Ar behostot ofurani dón zoma goro, zeṛe sur o hãse nu aibo, fuk zuke o hoti gori no faribo.
Kiyollahoile zeṛe tũwarar dón, heṛe tũwarar dil o takibo."

content: Adomor Futolla suk han kula rako

content.text: "Tũwarar kiyail bandi tiyar tako edde serag zalai rako.
Ar tũwara en mainšor ḍoilla o, zitara hitarar malik biyar melattu firi aiyer ne sai take, zendilla neki malik ai dorozat ṭulki dile, hitara malikore toratori doroza kuli di fare.
Šuki he gulam okkol, zarare góror malike ai seton dekibo. Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, he malike kiyail bandi hitarare hánar ṭebilot buwaibo edde ḍake zai hitarare luid goribo.
Šuki hitara, zarare góror malike ada raitta ba dolfohor ode hetunot ai o seton dekibo.
Kintu iyan buzo: Sur hon šomoi loi aibo hiyan zodi góror malike zainto, toile seton takito, nizor górot šingar dito no dito.
Hetolla tũwara o tiyar tako, kiyollahoile ze šomot mone no goriba, he šomot Adomor Fut aibo."

content: Hetunot Fitore fusar goredde, "Malik, ei mesal ki õne ãrare hodde naki beggunore hodde?"

content.text: "He biššaši, buddiwala menezar hiba honnuwa, zare hitar malike hibar gulam okkolor uwore buwaibo hitarare ṭãim motabek hána dibolla.
Šuki he gulam, zare malike ai hendilla goredde dekibo.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, hitare he góror malike hár kissur uwore zimma dibo.
Kintu mone goro! He gulame zodi mone mone ho, ãr malik aite aro deri ase hoi gulam edde bandi okkolore mara dora gore edde há fiya gori fól owa šuru gore.
Ze din Malik aibo hoi ofekka no gore edde ze šomoir hota hite no zane, he dinor he šomot he gulamor malik aibo edde hitare haṛi bag gori obiššaši okkolor fũwati hitar zaga ṭik goribo.
"He gulam ze hitar nizor malikor issa zane, tarfore o hite tiyar no o ba malikor issa mozin no gore hitare beši fiṛa diya zaibo.
Kintu ekzone hiyan no zane edde fiṛa faibar ham goijje, hitare hom šaza diya oibo. Zare beši diya oiye, hitattu beši dabi gora oibo, ar mainše zar hãse beši rake, hitattu beši uwafes lo.
"Ãi duniyait oin zalaito aiššyi. Ar ehon zodi ãi issa goijjilamde mozin he oin zolito!
Kintu ãttu dukkor torikotor gusol muwamui owa foribo, ar hiyan furon no o foijjionto ãi hoto sifor butore asi!
Tũwara ki mone goror, ãi ki duniyaire šanti dito aiššyi? Ãi tũwarare hoir, hen no, bolke hiyanor ulda.
Ehonottu loti ek góror fãszon aleda oibo, tinzon duizonor bifokke, duizon tinzonor bifokke lagibo.
Baf fuwar bifokke, ba fuwa bafor bifokke, ma ziyor bifokke, ba zi mar bifokke, hori bouwor bifokke ba bou horir bifokke lagibo."
"Tũwara zehon fosimottu miyula uṛede deko, hetunot onegane ho, 'Zór aibo', ar hendilla o.
Ar zẽtte doinottu bataš badde deho, hetunot ho, 'Beši roidor gorom oibo,' ar hendilla o.
Munafek okkol! Tũwara duniyai edde asmanor baf buzi faro, kintu ei ṭaim buzi no faror, iyan honḍoilla hota?
"Niyai oinnai tũwara nize bisar gori kiya no sor?

Zẽtte tũwara bifokkor manušor fũwati bisarharor hãse zo, fõtot maze rehai faibolla kušiš goro, ar no oile hite tũwarare bisarharor hãse ṭani loizaibo. Ar bisarhare fulišor hatot gosai dibo edde fuliše tũware ziyol golai eribo.
Ãi tore hoir: Zetodin šeš foiša foijjonto fũzi no felos, hetodin tui hono mote hentu baire ai no faribi."
